chapter: Piano players, Hot Springs and Chicago
title: Fish fries and early piano players: Deku, Chinese Charlie, Juby
summary: Asked about back-alley fish fries, he names piano players Walter Deku, Chinese Charlie and Juby who played them.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Talking about picnics. Did you ever play on fish fries and so on? Oh, that's, I'm talking about twenty years ago. In the early days, Mark.

Yeah, twenty years ago, the back alley fish fries. Back alley fish fries. Piano in the backyard. Did you play for yourself or? No, I just played the piano myself. You know, the honk-ton. What kind of numbers did you play? Well, we played mostly blues, you know, whatever I knew. I was playing good piano one time, you know. Because I was playing with Pico, and I was playing with Albert Francis, and then I was playing piano. I played two years and I must have played passable anyhow.
Could you tell me something about other piano players who also played on fish fries, songs, violences and stuff.

Oh. Well, Deku used to play. This boy used to play. Boynton El Centiocho used to play. Fish fries. Right. But he was an early piano player. He learned how to play piano early when he died young. He was thirty years old when he died. I know, baby, when he got dope, you know. Oh boy. Well, I don't even smoke a good cigarette. Yeah, brother.
Do you smoke bad cigarettes? Huh? Do you smoke bad cigarettes? Who? You said you don't smoke good cigarettes? I don't smoke no kind of cigarettes. Oh, I'm sorry. No.

No. I don't smoke no kind of cigarettes. Nothing, huh? Nothing. No. But I mean, brother said, yeah. This guy, yeah, he's still living. Walter Deku. You know him, man? Yeah. Well, he's still living. Well, he died young, too. What did he play? Piano. He was a piano. He did also play all these fish fries. Huh? Yeah, he played a lot of fish fries. What? Chinese Charlie. Chinese Charlie. I don't know. I called him Chinese Charlie. That's all I know. He used to like tell the role of Mokin. Yeah.

What do you mean by a crip? One of his special numbers. Well, he was a good piano player. Yeah? Juby. I know Juby. He was a good piano player, too. Juby? Juby. Well, them fellas all come over 20, over 30 years ago, you know. Yeah. That's the fellas that I knew. Well, then when I was a young guy, too, you know. He was just coming up, playing.
